discrepancies: Chart GLM 4.5 $2.20 (Jul 25), 5 $3.20 (Feb 26), 5.1/5.2 $4.40 (Apr 26), 5.3 $4.40 (Aug 26) all match Z.ai International pricing. The chart's GLM line is the flagship tier; Air/Flash models ($1.1 to $0.4 to $0.5) are a separate tier and are not on the chart.

GLM-4.5 launch month: the 2025-07-28 14:50 UTC snapshot does not list GLM-4.5 and the 2025-08-05 snapshot does. Two secondary sources (modelcompare.dev: 2025-07-28; cloudprice.net: 2025-07-25) both put it in July, so Jul 25 is kept. Sources: https://web.archive.org/web/20250728145000/https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing and https://web.archive.org/web/20250805100226/https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing
Output price per tier does not follow generation numbers: GLM-5 $3.2, GLM-5-Turbo $4.0 (Mar-Apr 2026), GLM-5.1 $4.4. Flagship tier uses the top model only.
gaps: Jan-Jun 2025: Z.ai (international) had no pricing page on docs.z.ai before Jul 2025; the earliest Wayback capture is 2025-07-28 and earlier GLM-4 series pricing was on bigmodel.cn in CNY. No USD price found for Jan-Jun 2025, so no points are given for those months.
GLM-4.7-FlashX release date: first seen Feb 11 2026; the release-notes page lists no entry for it, so the Air/Flash tier point for Jan 26 stays on GLM-4.5-Air.
